title: Mintu Ka Homework Ninja Trick!
visual_style: Bright, 2D cartoon animation style with expressive anime-like reactions, vibrant Indian household background.

characters.name: Mintu
characters.appearance: Messy black hair, wheatish skin tone, mischievous round eyes, average height for a 10-year-old.
characters.clothing: Red t-shirt with a cartoon rocket printed on the front, blue shorts.
characters.personality: Super clever, lazy, mischievous, loves shortcuts.

characters.name: Mummy
characters.appearance: Long black hair tied in a neat ponytail, sharp observant eyes, wheatish skin tone.
characters.clothing: Yellow cotton salwar kameez with a small floral print, green dupatta draped over her shoulder.
characters.personality: Strict, observant, clever, loving yet terrifying when angry.

scenes.narration: Wait... agar invisible ink se homework kiya, toh Mummy ko dikhega hi nahi! Genius!
scenes.dialogue: Mintu: "Bro, history create hone wali hai! Invisible homework!"
scenes.action: Mintu sits at his study table with a huge Maths notebook. He dips his brush in a small bowl of lemon juice and smirks with overconfidence.
scenes.background: Colorful Indian children's bedroom with study table, books stacked messily, and a colorful cartoon poster on the wall.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up shot focusing on Mintu's face and hands.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, a 10-year-old boy with messy black hair, wearing a red rocket t-shirt and blue shorts, sits at a wooden study table. He dips a brush into a bowl of lemon juice with a mischievous smirk.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation style. Warm indoor lighting, expressive anime-like reactions, detailed background with stacked books and a cartoon wall poster.

scenes.narration: Zero efforts, full swag ka plan!
scenes.dialogue: Mintu: "Done! Zero efforts, full swag! Ab Mummy aayegi toh bolunga invisible ink magic hai."
scenes.action: Mintu quickly scribbles nonsense wiggly lines with lemon juice on the paper, then proudly closes his notebook with a wide grin.
scenes.background: Colorful Indian children's bedroom with study table.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, slight pan following his hand.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu closing his Maths notebook with a proud smile, having scribbled nonsense lines using lemon juice on the blank page.

scenes.narration: Shortcut ka maza, tab pe saza!
scenes.dialogue: Mintu: *(Panicking)* "Arre yaar, Mummy! Itni jaldi? Wait, act casual!"
scenes.action: Mintu slides the notebook away, pulls out his tablet, and starts playing a video game frantically. Suddenly, the door creaks open and Mummy enters holding a steaming cup of tea.
scenes.background: Indian children's bedroom, doorway visible in the background.
scenes.camera: Wide shot shifting to a medium shot as Mummy enters.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu frantically sliding his notebook away and pretending to play a video game on a tablet as his mother enters the room carrying a tea cup.

scenes.narration: Mummy ki entry aur pakde jaane ka darr!
scenes.dialogue: Mintu: *(Sweating)* "Mummy woh... chemistry experiment chal raha hai!"; Mummy: "Mintu beta, maths ka homework ho gaya ya invisible ink se aliens le gaye?"
scenes.action: Mummy stands right behind Mintu, tapping her foot crossly. She looks down at the completely clean, blank notebook left on the desk.
scenes.background: Study table setting inside a brightly lit Indian bedroom.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot from Mummy's perspective looking down at Mintu.
scenes.visual_description: Mummy standing behind Mintu with her arms crossed, tapping her foot, looking suspiciously at the blank page of the maths notebook while Mintu sweats nervously.

scenes.narration: Mummy ka ek naya desi hack!
scenes.dialogue: Mummy: "Achha? Chal, thoda ironing bhi kar lete hain notebook pe. Dekhte hain invisible ink kaise chamakti hai!"
scenes.action: Mummy smiles dangerously, picks up a hot clothes iron from the corner of the room, and places it right flat onto the blank notebook page.
scenes.background: Study table with books, pens, and the iron cord stretching across the room.
scenes.camera: Close-up tracking shot on the iron touching the paper.
scenes.visual_description: Mummy smiling with a scary expression, firmly placing a hot clothes iron directly onto the blank page of Mintu's notebook.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation style. In the foreground, 10-year-old Mintu (messy black hair, red rocket t-shirt) watches in sheer terror. Bright indoor lighting, dramatic humorous angle, vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: Invisible ink ka sach aur chappal-level ka darr!
scenes.dialogue: Mintu: *(Crying/Laughing)* "Arre Mummy, mazak tha! Full problem ho gayi! Ab toh zero milega!"; Mummy: "Homework ka shortcut nahi, dimag ka use karo beta!"
scenes.action: Zzzzt! Steam rises as the lemon juice turns brown under the heat, revealing funny scribbles and a big smiley face. Mummy gives him the ultimate strict glare.
scenes.background: Study table filled with smoke effects and steam rising from the notebook.
scenes.camera: Dynamic zoom-out shot showing both characters reacting.
scenes.visual_description: The iron heats up the lemon juice, turning it brown to reveal sloppy handwriting and a smiley face. Mintu is crying dramatically while Mummy gives him a stern look with her hand on her hip.

ending_lesson: Shortcuts se sirf time waste hota hai, kaam toh karna hi padta hai! 😉
